media_credentials.create:
CREATE TABLE media_credentials (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	character_scope VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT '' NOT NULL, 
	provider VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_secret TEXT, 
	fingerprint VARCHAR(32), 
	revision INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_media_credential_scope UNIQUE (owner_id, character_scope, provider, purpose)
)

media_assets.create:
CREATE TABLE media_assets (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	scope_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	storage_key VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	content_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	content_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	byte_size INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	width INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	height INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER DEFAULT '1' NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'draft' NOT NULL, 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	expires_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (storage_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_media_asset_size CHECK (byte_size > 0 AND width > 0 AND height > 0)
)

image_interpretations.create:
CREATE TABLE image_interpretations (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	cache_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	asset_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	scope_key VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	asset_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	model VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	thinking_level VARCHAR(8) NOT NULL, 
	credential_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(24) DEFAULT 'queued' NOT NULL, 
	lease_token VARCHAR(64),

	description TEXT,

	result_json TEXT, 
	error_code VARCHAR(80), 
	created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(asset_id) REFERENCES media_assets (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_image_interpretation_cache UNIQUE (cache_key)
)
